title: Nf Maxorder Round4
objective: Implement an explicit modified Round-4 local maximal-order algorithm with inspectable stages, exact certificates, selector inputs, and differential regressions from P3

handoff.summary: Implements ordinary-Python modified Round-4 planning and execution: exact modular arithmetic, certified multifactor Hensel refinement, Dedekind coefficient-ring integral elements, canonical HNF/local discriminant evidence, stable serializable traces, pure selector metrics, fail-closed strict mode, and thin adapters for shared maximal-order contracts. Frozen PARI/Ford-Letard regressions and deterministic randomized degree-2-through-4 differentials agree with the existing Round-2 implementation.
risks: The Ford-Letard primary power-basis search is not implemented in this lane; deep primary branches explicitly record and use Round 2, or raise Round4Unsupported in strict mode.

The pure Sage.js orchestration path is currently slower than native Round 2 on the four benchmark cases; the intended performance follow-up is native compilation of the same-source polynomial stages and one-crossing P2 integration.

pnpm test:changed rebuilt successfully but its unit tier saw two unrelated integration-workspace failures: another live worktree had unsafe native-cache symlinks, and this lane cannot claim the central test runner manifest needed to register test/number-field-round4.cjs.

The full native suite restored newer shared-cache FLINT artifacts containing the two c0c67dcf order-resource exports onto this older lane base, then correctly failed exact FFI ratchets (400 generated functions versus this base's 398); FLINT, FFLAS, graph, and M4RI package suites passed before that integration mismatch.
next_steps: Integration lane: add test/number-field-round4.cjs to the central host test manifest and add round4.py to pyrightconfig.json after cherry-pick.
Wire modified_round4_hnf_contract and round4_selection_decision into the shared maximal-order dispatcher introduced by ef0595fb.
Compile the exact polynomial/Hensel source transparently at P2 and implement the remaining Ford-Letard primary power-basis search before selecting Round 4 for that domain.
